original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

scope_change_reason: The drawn card was connector-alphabet-change (scope key ff4f5113ed2256ab19ed; drawn track recursive-interfaces). This session takes the explicitly assigned kappa-blocker KB1 request instead: every mechanism package ends with 'no supplier instance exists, so no kappa change follows', so build a physical or hosted supplier instantiation of one certified mechanism with the priced whole-construction budget and the a < D/E diagnostic. Taking an explicit open request in place of the drawn card is the recorded scope change (autoresearch.md section 3). The drawn connector-alphabet-change and joint-query-controller cards are also live-claimed on 2026-10-15 (Cycle 43/44 claims, PRs 2249/2259/2391), and two of the three named KB1 candidates (DUO connector words, R439 star absorption) carry fresh same-day claims, so the instantiated mechanism is the unclaimed z4 order-four typed echo, registered under the centre-path-sharing card because that is the lever the instantiation prices.
actual_scope: Instantiate the certified z4 order-four typed echo (PR1391 five-child contract; PR1410 persistent pair) as a supplier instance for two-call centre sharing: smallest falsifying typed pair k=2 first (all 16 phase paths, all 56 basis columns = every dirty state, literal inverse, three schedule mutants), the priced whole-construction physical budget in one declared tape model (dispatch, instruction fetch, coefficient fetch, reads, writes, address travel, descriptor storage, data storage) for joint vs separate schedules at k=2 and k=5+5, and the hosted aggregate ledgers with exact moments and the a < D/E diagnostic on the selected complex ledger (m=73, W=14336, N=144). One documented obstruction (hosting: COPY/ERASE window-lifetime and per-call totals delivery) and one bounded pivot (single-call realization).
bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of the ~99.6 unpaid coordinates per call on the binding complex side; the certified typed echo is a concrete candidate mechanism for the 'centre path shared by two calls' lever (levers.py: 1.90x). Instantiating it converts the lever from a planning relaxation into a priced word-level construction with its exact overhead, or fails precisely where hosting blocks it.
